newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midwest hogs seen steady-$0.50 lower - trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midwest hogs seen steady-$0.50 lower - trade.

text.p: U.S. Midwest direct cash hog prices Friday were seen steady to $0.50 per cwt lower, pressured by increased hog marketings amid moderating temperatures, livestock dealers and packer buyers said.
Hog movement was restricted earlier this week by an Arctic blast through the central U.S. and blizzard conditions in the Dakotas, northern Iowa and southern Minnesota.

Top prices for hogs delivered to the plant in Iowa and southern Minnesota Friday could range from $55.00 to $56.00, sources there said. Illinois top prices at plants were seen at $56.00 to $57.00 and Indiana/Ohio top prices at $54.50-$55.00.
